svd_relative_cutoff: sqrt(float64 epsilon); fixed numerical truncation, not selected from accuracy
purpose: Diagnose the frozen rejected release; do not install fitted coefficients or create a new defense.
fitting: Three diagnostic least-squares fits on the existing 256 unlabeled training calibration images, all tokens; no optimizer or gradient steps.
evaluation: The first 256 images of the already inspected training confirmation set; not new validation or official test.
interpretation: A truncated numerical least-squares residual is not a rigorous lower bound for the unconstrained real-valued problem. Representation error is not a classification bound.
scope: No causal separation of compression, branch transfer, regularization or accumulated earlier errors. No parameter selection, attack claim or novelty claim.
